FEAT-4-STORY-17.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
FEAT-4-STORY-17.description: Create a standardized Pydantic response model for provider detail lookup including NPI, name, taxonomy, status, locations, and validated external links to ensure consistent contract between domain service and facade.

FEAT-4-STORY-18.title: Expose Provider Detail Lookup via Evaluate Care Facade
FEAT-4-STORY-18.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade and expose as a tool-accessible method for agent use, ensuring proper input validation and response formatting.

FEAT-4-STORY-19.title: Register Provider Detail Tool in Tool Router
FEAT-4-STORY-19.description: Add provider detail lookup as an allowlisted tool in the tool_router with Pydantic input validation and ensure compatibility with Anthropic tool_use flow.

FEAT-4-STORY-20.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
FEAT-4-STORY-20.description: Implement unit tests for provider_detail_service and integration tests covering facade and tool_router execution path, including NPI lookup success, partial data, and failure scenarios.
